Dynamique commerciale et présence renfor: Commercial momentum and strengthened presence of manufacturers at the Paris Motor Show
L'édition 2026 du Mondial de l'automobil: The 2026 edition of the Paris Motor Show is recording positive momentum, driven by the display of new models and concepts by sixty manufacturers. Although luxury brands are absent from the event, the presentation areas have been elaborately designed. Notably, the Smart brand features an original installation comprising two large legs, while other players have relied on expanded exhibition spaces.
Les constructeurs chinois ont accentué l: Chinese manufacturers have stepped up their presence with nearly twenty brands represented at the show. In terms of stand surface area, the Chery group and the AITO brand rank second and third respectively, ahead of European manufacturers such as Peugeot, Volkswagen, and Mercedes. The Renault brand retains the largest exhibition area at the show.
La journée d'ouverture au public, le mar: The public opening day on Tuesday, October 13, was marked by a steady flow of visitors until mid-afternoon, leading to numerous inquiries for the sales teams at the stands. Despite current difficulties in the automotive sector and political discussions held at the Paris Automotive Summit on October 13, European brand executives are adopting a less alarmist tone than in recent years.
